statement.text: History-adjacent is the numerical validation-AUC maximum, 0.6149987417422075, only +9.8962e-6 above fixed; full retains lower Logloss and history-adjacent harms the empty-history slice.
Adjacent-minus-half AUC is +0.0002689085 across histories and +0.0001688723 within actions; loss improves by 6.44e-7 and 0.0001007946 respectively. Both rules remain single-seed.

The half-rotation penalty is not evidence that every reassignment harms ranking. Adjacent recovery weakens exact-own-scale necessity; it does not identify temporal relevance. Positive scale correlation, smaller donor time/index gaps and optimizer coupling remain competing accounts.
Action preservation alone is inadequate for these observed rules: action-half still loses while history-adjacent recovers with sampled action mismatches. No general necessity/sufficiency claim.

Prioritize the fixed full/fixed plus grouping-by-offset suite at paired seeds 43/44 only in a later authorized phase after source audit and budget refresh. Defer mean/projection/crossed/count replication; their limitations persist.

plan.question: Does the observed ordering-by-offset interaction in backward scale donation survive paired initializations, and what evidence can distinguish scale-to-gradient-direction coupling from seed-specific optimization? Chronological adjacent-minus-half validation AUC is +0.0002689085, whereas inverse-norm-ranked adjacent-minus-half is -0.0000770824 (difference in differences -0.0003459909). The chronological-half bridge exactly reproduces its ancestor. Rank-half is the current AUC leader (0.6151021885), but rank-adjacent has lower Logloss (0.1965201288 versus 0.1965325839). All are seed 42; deterministic replays are not independent repetitions. Thus neither temporal locality nor positive own/donor scale correlation is established as necessary, and negative correlation is not established as beneficial. Retrieve the complete latest and preceding memory records to retain their alternatives, failed scientific directions, controls and budget reservations. Prioritize a later authorized, precommitted repetition of the existing four ordering-by-offset cells plus full and fixed-tangent anchors before another donor or architecture sweep. Such repetition tests robustness, not independent mechanism attribution. Any subsequent mechanism claim also needs common-state gradient/update evidence; preserving scalar scale moments does not preserve accumulated gradient norms or Adam dynamics. No model execution, final suite freeze or withheld assessment is requested in this query phase.
missing_information: Paired-seed outcomes for the frozen six-arm suite: full, fixed tangent, chronological adjacent/half and inverse-norm-ranked adjacent/half. Seeds 43 and 44 are unobserved. Precommit AUC interaction and candidate-minus-anchor contrasts and report all Logloss/cost results; instability or nonpositive candidate-minus-anchor means weakens superiority. Do not treat additional seeds as new mechanism contrasts.

Authorized candidate source/config/checkpoint access and execution commands. The query workspace exports no model files or ancestor sources. Receipt hashes and bounded candidate-authored diagnostics do not independently verify common forward computation, initialization, data order, checkpoint selection, stable rank tie handling, masks, floors or actual tensor VJPs.

Training-time scale-to-gradient-direction relationships, accumulated per-parameter gradient norms, Adam moments and update norms at common states. First-512 validation diagnostics show scale correlation and moment conservation, but cannot establish mediation or equal optimization cost. Any later probe must be authorized, prospectively specified and budgeted.

Controls separating scale rank and tie structure from donor chronology, repeated fields and recipient gradient directions. Existing ordering-by-offset cells establish neither a causal temporal mechanism nor a benefit of negative scale correlation. Preserve the negative action-mean, action-half and chronology-half findings rather than explain them away.

Authorized per-sample predictions and user identities for paired user-cluster intervals. Current aggregate metrics cannot supply those intervals. Existing slice findings are exploratory, overlap, and include small positive counts; missing/unseen-field population slices are not supplied.

Primary normalization/surrogate-gradient prior work beyond inherited target-aware pooling. The bounded paper search returned DIN/DMR provenance entries rather than a verified close backward-donation method. Priority and novelty remain unverified; external industry architectures are not evidence for the local donor mechanism or a reason to add a readout intervention.
